title: Pure Mekk-Knight
summary: Mekk-Knight monsters with their World Legacy Spells and Traps and generic staples. Every Mekk-Knight summons itself into a column that already holds two cards, so the opponent's own board feeds the deck. Mekk-Knight Blue Sky searches a Mekk-Knight for each opposing card in its column, and Purple Nightfall banishes a Mekk-Knight until your next turn to search another. Girsu, the Orcust Mekk-Knight sends a World Legacy card to the GY and makes World Legacy Tokens, one for each player, which give you a column even against an empty board. Enlilgirsu needs an Orcust Link Monster, so it stays on the Orcust list. The World Legacy Traps negate effects in a Mekk-Knight's column.
main: Mekk-Knight Blue Sky
Searches a Mekk-Knight for each opposing card in its column.
Mekk-Knight Purple Nightfall
Banishes a Mekk-Knight until your next turn to search another.
Girsu, the Orcust Mekk-Knight
Sends a World Legacy card to the GY; tokens on both fields open a column.
Mekk-Knight Indigo Eclipse
Moves a Mekk-Knight to another column on either turn.
Mekk-Knight Red Moon
Destroys a monster in its column.
Mekk-Knight Yellow Star
Destroys a Spell/Trap in its column.
Mekk-Knight Green Horizon
Returns a Mekk-Knight from the GY when it battles in its column.
Mekk-Knight Orange Sunset
Summons a Mekk-Knight from the hand when a card leaves its column.
World Legacy's Memory
Quick-Play: summons a Mekk-Knight from the Deck until the End Phase.
World Legacy Scars
Field Spell: discards a Mekk-Knight to draw.
World Legacy Key
Recovers a banished Mekk-Knight; negates Traps in their columns.
World Legacy's Secret
Revives a Level 5+ monster; negates monster effects in their columns.
World Legacy Whispers
Negates Spells in a Mekk-Knight's column.
extra: Link-3: sends a card from its column to summon a Mekk-Knight from the Deck.
Link-2: discards to search a World Legacy card.
Link-4: untargetable, the only monster they can attack.
